_comment: M8.0's trace of the movies (docs/FFMPEG_MIGRATION_PLAN.md section 2): development lifts only (tools/m8_trace_lift.sh merges these with config/r7_native_hooks.json's observers). The game's movie class (the seven methods the scenes call), (Bink's eleven functions behind the call stubs 0x009873A8-0x00987458 were observed until M8.4 excluded Bink from the lift; the native player answers at the stubs), the movie textures' creation (gcmtextures), the four functions that build a movie's path, the asp engine's movie schedule manager and the Lua binding named Ending. port/native/movie/movie_trace.cpp logs each call's arguments and results (DOTHEROES_MOVIE_TRACE=<file>). Addresses only: the lifted bodies run unchanged.
